description: This file defines a UI Fragment named FavoritesFragment which displays a list of favorite items retrieved from a FavoritesRepository. It manages the display of favorite content, updates the view when favorites are removed, and handles the fragment lifecycle events.

classes.name: FavoritesFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of favorite videos, allowing users to remove favorites and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view, sets up the repository, and configures the RecyclerView.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the list of favorite items displayed, shows or hides the empty view, and sets up the adapter with an onRemove callback.
